// content schemas: Maps each content file to its generated JSON Schema, giving autocomplete and
inline errors while authoring. Regenerate with `npm run schema` after changing
schema/dsl.ts, the tuning constants, or the entity id sets — test/content/
schema-fresh.test.ts fails if the committed schemas fall behind.
The mapping lives here rather than as a `$schema` key inside each file because the
content files are flat id-keyed maps: a `$schema` key would parse as a card (or
relic, or hero) named `$schema` and fail the key-matches-id check.
